questions.learningObjective: Distinguish between the input and output in function notation
questions.question: In the statement \( g(7) = 36 \) for the function \( g(n) = 4n + 8 \), which value is the input and which is the output?

options.label: C
options.text: 7 is the input; 36 is the output.

options.label: D
options.text: 36 is the input; 7 is the output.

questions.explanation: In function notation g(input) = output, the value inside the parentheses (7) is the input, and the result (36) is the output.
questions.hint: The value inside the parentheses is always the input; the value the function produces is the output.
